artist_scope: full contract (Tier 2, the state-branching class: geckolib_migration_design.md section 5); the rig is not yet in-game (it lands through the seam in a later slice)
character_sheet: A hostile theropod the size of a house: a chest and a belly, a three-piece neck to a long skull with a hinged two-piece lower jaw and twenty-three teeth, two three-piece legs on seven-piece clawed feet, a four-piece tail and three back spikes (ModelNastysaurus.java:152-386, 59 parts), drawn at x1.5. 200 HP, 32 damage, 17 armour, speed 0.35 (Nastysaurus.java:266-275). On a 1-in-5 tick it picks the nearest living thing in a 32-block box - anything but its own kind, the Cryolophosaurus, the Velocity Raptor and a creative player (:141-175, :240-264) - chases it at 1.25 and, within 4.5 blocks plus half the target's width, rolls its bite on a 1-in-5 cadence (:89-90; DinosaurMeleeAttackGoal.Presets.nastysaurus; BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:159-174), landing 32 with a 1.2 knockback (:311-326). The synched DATA_ATTACKING int (:41-42) is held at 1 while it stands in reach and dropped when it chases or stands down (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:132, :145, :168, :176). It spawns in the dark at night above y 50 under five blocks of clear air, no other within 16 (:358-368; ModEntities.java:117-118). Read it as a big theropod: a heavy two-legged stride with the feet lifting and sliding, the tail counter-swinging, the jaws working.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.5 of the rig (NastysaurusRenderer.java:20, :30; shadow 1.5, :23) on a 512x256 sheet (ModelNastysaurus.java:388), nastysaurus.png (NastysaurusRenderer.java:15); the hitbox is 2.2 x 4.6 (ModEntities.java:117-118). The legs are position chains the code re-places each tick (ModelNastysaurus.java:472-492, :503-523): key the joints, not the positions.

groups.name: gait
groups.axis: x (and the foot's y / z position)
groups.amplitude: lower leg: pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) x the walking speed about -0.523; thigh and shin: pi x 0.06 = 0.188 rad (11 deg) x the speed about -0.576 and 0.977; the foot (all seven claw pieces) slides 10 px fore-aft (5 x pscale 2) with the cosine and lifts 4 px (2 x 2) x the speed on the positive half of the sine; the thigh and shin are placed 17 px up the lower leg's angle each tick; the right leg runs half a cycle behind (+ pi); no threshold (> 0.001)
groups.plain: a heavy two-legged stride: each lower leg swings from its foot, the foot sliding forward and back and lifting on the up-swing, the thigh and shin following at a smaller angle; the right leg in counter-phase
groups.math: c = cos(t * 0.65 / 2) (right: + pi), s = sin(...), both 0 when amount <= 0.001; lclaw*.y = 21 - (s > 0 ? s * 4 * amount : 0); lclaw*.z = 15 + 10 * c * amount; leftleg3.y/z = lclaw1.y/z; leftleg3.xRot = -0.523 + c * pi * 0.15 * amount; leftleg1.xRot = -0.576 + c * pi * 0.06 * amount; leftleg2.xRot = 0.977 + c * pi * 0.06 * amount; leftleg1/2.y = leftleg3.y - cos(leftleg3.xRot) * 17; leftleg1/2.z = leftleg3.z - sin(leftleg3.xRot) * 17; the right leg likewise; every claw xRot = 0
groups.source: ModelNastysaurus.java:461-529; wingspeed 0.65 (:25), pscale 2 (:394), clawZ 15 / clawY 21 / clawZamp 10 / clawYamp 4 (:397-400)
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.65 / 2 = 0.325: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.325 = 19.3 ticks

groups.name: jaw
groups.amplitude: attacking: pi x 0.16 = 0.503 rad (29 deg) about a 0.5 rad open rest at 0.85 x 0.65 = 0.5525 rad/tick; not attacking: shut at pi/16 = 0.196 rad, except that on one wrap in twenty of a 13.8-tick phase clock (0.7 x 0.65) the jaw runs one sine cycle of the same 29-degree chomp (a per-entity latch)
groups.plain: the lower jaw and its ten teeth chomp wide and fast while the attacking flag is up; shut at rest, with a random single chomp now and then
groups.math: a = attacking ? 0.5 + cos(t * 0.85 * 0.65) * pi * 0.16 : (latch ? 0.5 + sin(t * 0.85 * 0.65) * pi * 0.16 : pi / 16); jaw1.xRot = jaw5.xRot = tooth14..23.xRot = a; the latch: phase = |t * 0.7 * 0.65 mod 2pi|; on each wrap (phase < last) ri1 = nextInt(20) == 1
groups.phase: the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (Nastysaurus.java:41-42, held at 1 within reach: BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168, dropped :132 / :145 / :176) selects the chomp; the idle twitch is a client-side roll
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.85 x 0.65 = 0.5525: the natural period is 11.4 ticks; the idle latch's clock is x 0.7 x 0.65 = 0.455 (13.8 ticks per wrap)

groups.name: tail
groups.amplitude: calm: tail3 pi x 0.08 / 2 = 0.126 rad (7 deg), tail4 pi x 0.08 = 0.251 rad (14 deg) at 0.26 x 0.65 = 0.169 rad/tick; attacking: tail3 pi x 0.25 / 2 = 0.393 rad (22 deg), tail4 pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) at 0.76 x 0.65 = 0.494 rad/tick; the tip is placed 11 px along the third piece's yaw
groups.plain: the last two tail pieces sway side to side, the tip twice as far as the piece before it: slow and small at rest, fast and wide while attacking
groups.math: ts, amp = attacking ? (0.76, 0.25) : (0.26, 0.08); tail3.yRot = cos(t * ts * 0.65) * pi * amp / 2; tail4.z = tail3.z + cos(tail3.yRot) * 11; tail4.x = tail3.x + sin(tail3.yRot) * 11; tail4.yRot = cos(t * ts * 0.65) * pi * amp
groups.phase: the synched DATA_ATTACKING int selects the rate and width
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.26 x 0.65 calm (a 37-tick period) and x 0.76 x 0.65 attacking (a 12.7-tick period)

behaviour: One gait rhythm with no threshold (ModelNastysaurus.java:461-529): each lower leg swings 27 degrees x the walking speed from its foot at 0.325 rad/tick (a 19-tick period), the thigh and shin 11 degrees, the whole foot of seven claw pieces sliding 10 px fore-aft and lifting 4 px on the up-swing; the thigh and shin are re-placed 17 px up the lower leg each tick; the right leg runs half a cycle behind the left.

Two branches on the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (Nastysaurus.java:41-42), which the melee goal holds at 1 while the dinosaur stands within 4.5 blocks plus half the target's width and drops when it chases or the goal stops (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:132, :145, :168, :176): attacking, the lower jaw and its ten teeth chomp 29 degrees about a half-open rest at 0.5525 rad/tick (:431-433, :452-459) and the last two tail pieces lash 22 and 45 degrees at 0.494 rad/tick (:540-543, :548-551); calm, the jaw sits shut at 11 degrees and the tail sways 7 and 14 degrees at 0.169 rad/tick (:544-546).

At rest the jaw has a random twitch: a per-entity latch (:404, :437-450; Nastysaurus.java:46-55) rerolls one chance in twenty on every wrap of a 13.8-tick phase clock and, when it hits, runs one sine cycle of the attacking chomp - a client-side roll, not a synched state.

The head turns with the look at 0.35 of the head yaw: the middle neck takes half of it, the top neck, both skull pieces, the lower jaw and all twenty-three teeth the full angle (:406-429); nothing pitches. The chest, belly, neck base, the first two tail pieces and the three back spikes are static.

The bite is doHurtTarget (Nastysaurus.java:311-326: 32 of damage and a 1.2 knockback) from the goal's swing roll (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:170-173, nextInt(4) == 0 or nextInt(5) == 1 on a 1-in-5 cadence tick in reach) - no animation event today.

wishlist: in `walk`: the code's stride is stiff — the thigh and shin swing only 11 degrees (ModelNastysaurus.java:489-490) and the foot slides on the ground (:476, :485-487); a real theropod step with a knee bend and a foot plant, and a body bob to match the 1.5x scale
in `aggro_idle`: the 45-degree tail lash (:540-543, :551) and the chomp (:431-433) are there — add a lowered head and a stance shift so the reach-of-bite state reads as a threat
in `attack`: a head lunge on the bite — the neck is yaw-only in the code (:406-410); the bite lands 32 within 4.5 blocks plus half the target's width (Nastysaurus.java:311-326)
in `idle`: the back spikes and the first two tail pieces are static (:376-386, :200-207); a breath through the belly and a tail root sway
